neighbours.label: 'own' or 'finest' after a place possessive, naming a local champion (Brooklyn's own, Europe's finest); a possessive person's 'own' or a plain superlative does not fire
fire: Tonight the club welcomes Detroit's own Marcus Lee for a two-hour set.

Headlining the fair is Nashville's own Carla James and her band.
The menu was created by three of Italy's finest pastry chefs.
Next up on the podcast is Glasgow's own comedian Rory Hart.
Some of Africa's finest runners will compete in the marathon.

predictions: 'own'/'finest' after a place name + 's reaches 0.4-0.7; 'her own car', 'the finest player', and the same people introduced without the place possessive stay under 0.1. Title-case 'Best' after a place possessive is weaker (about 0.25).
